context:
Reuse `PLATFORM_EXTRA_OPTS` and the `benchbox_run_argv()` command builder
rather than special-casing PostgreSQL-family adapters. Keep the credential

description:
The corrected enabled-platform UAT run from 2026-05-12 failed every
`pg-duckdb`, `pg-mooncake`, and `timescaledb` cell before benchmark-specific
execution with `fe_sendauth: no password supplied`.

Evidence is in `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_enabled_today_platforms_20260512`:
`command-status.json` returned 2 after 1036.4s; `matrix_summary.tsv` recorded
22/22 failures for each PostgreSQL-extension platform; `cells.jsonl` shows the
first error as a missing password; `uat_lifecycle.log` shows managed Docker
startup and teardown succeeded for those services.

The Docker compose files set `POSTGRES_PASSWORD=benchbox`, and adapter configs
accept a password. The UAT matrix builder does not pass one for these local
managed services, while `singlestore` already has an explicit local password
option. Fix the UAT harness/config path so local managed PostgreSQL-family
cells receive the credentials required by their compose stacks.
